knowledge:
- key_parameters: temper=A tempering scalar in EmissionParam() (e.g., temper=0.5) used to scale emission probabilities ;; TAUP=A transition parameter that scales the transition probability matrix, where larger values make it more expensive to transition from normal copy number to altered states ;; state=A parameter in FilterParam() used to select specific HMM states (e.g., states 1, 2, 5, and 6 for altered copy states) ;; min.gapwidth=A parameter in reduce() used to merge adjacent CNV calls (e.g., min.gapwidth=500e3)
- alternatives: crlmm package=Preferred for preprocessing raw SNP arrays to obtain log R ratios and B allele frequencies, and for converting CNSet objects directly to SnpArrayExperiment ;; ArrayTV package=Preferred for wave correction (GC content bias correction) of log R ratios before running the HMM
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to identify germline copy number variants (CNVs) and chromosomal alterations (deletions, duplications) from high-throughput SNP array data (Illumina or Affymetrix) using log R ratios (LRR) and B allele frequencies (BAF).
- pitfalls: Genomic waves correlating with GC content can bias copy number estimates, so wave correction (e.g., using ArrayTV or loess) is recommended before fitting the HMM ;; Adjacent hemizygous deletions or other CNV calls can sometimes be split into too many small regions, requiring the use of reduce() with an appropriate min.gapwidth to merge them ;; Function masking can occur, specifically for the genotypes function which is also in crlmm, so VanillaICE::genotypes should be used explicitly.

workflows.name: cnv_calling_from_text_files
workflows.intent: Parse raw text files (e.g., Illumina FinalReports) and a marker annotation file to construct an ArrayViews object, convert to a SnpExperiment, fit a 6-state HMM, filter CNV calls, and visualize them.
input: FinalReport*.txt (Illumina FinalReport files containing SNP Name, Allele1 - AB, Allele2 - AB, Log R Ratio, B Allele Freq)
SNP_info.csv (Marker annotation file containing Chr, Position, Name, Intensity Only)
workflows.stages: 1. Read and organize marker annotation into a SnpGRanges object ;; 2. Define an ArrayViews object pointing to the raw files and parsed output directory ;; 3. Define parsing parameters using CopyNumScanParams and parse the source files using parseSourceFile ;; 4. Load parsed data into a SnpArrayExperiment using SnpExperiment ;; 5. Define HMM emission parameters using EmissionParam and fit the HMM using hmm2 ;; 6. Filter CNV calls using FilterParam and cnvFilter ;; 7. Merge adjacent calls using reduce and visualize using xyplotList and xygrid
workflows.code:
features <- suppressWarnings(fread(file.path(extdir, "SNP_info.csv")))
fgr <- GRanges(paste0("chr", features$Chr), IRanges(features$Position, width=1), isSnp=features[["Intensity Only"]]==0)
fgr <- SnpGRanges(fgr)
names(fgr) <- features[["Name"]]
sl <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18)
seqlevels(fgr) <- sl[sl %in% seqlevels(fgr)]
seqinfo(fgr) <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18)[seqlevels(fgr),]
fgr <- sort(fgr)
views <- ArrayViews(rowRanges=fgr, sourcePaths=files, parsedPath=parsedDir)
lrrFile(views) <- file.path(parsedDir, basename(fileName(views, "lrr")))
views@bafFiles <- file.path(parsedDir, basename(fileName(views, "baf")))
views@gtFiles <- file.path(parsedDir, basename(fileName(views, "gt")))
colnames(views) <- gsub(".csv", "", colnames(views))
dat <- fread(files[1], skip="[Data]")
select_columns <- match(c("SNP Name", "Allele1 - AB", "Allele2 - AB", "Log R Ratio", "B Allele Freq"), names(dat))
index_genome <- match(names(fgr), dat[["SNP Name"]])
scan_params <- CopyNumScanParams(index_genome=index_genome, select=select_columns, cnvar="Log R Ratio", bafvar="B Allele Freq", gtvar=c("Allele1 - AB", "Allele2 - AB"))
parseSourceFile(views, scan_params)
snp_exp <- SnpExperiment(views[, 4:5])
param <- EmissionParam()
param <- EmissionParam(temper=0.5)
fit <- hmm2(snp_exp, param)
filter_param <- FilterParam()
cnvFilter(fit, filter_param)
select_cnv <- FilterParam(state=c("1", "2", "5", "6"), seqnames="chr22")
cnvs <- cnvFilter(fit, select_cnv)
trellis_param <- HmmTrellisParam()
cnvList <- split(cnvs, cnvs$id)
figList <- xyplotList(cnvList, snp_exp, trellis_param)
fig1 <- figList[["FinalReport6841.csv"]][[1]]
vps <- viewports()
xygrid(fig1, vps, cnvList[[1]][1])
cnvs_sample2r <- reduce(cnvs_sample2, min.gapwidth=500e3)
fig2 <- xyplotList(cnvs_sample2r, snp_exp)

workflows.name: cnv_calling_from_crlmm_cnset
workflows.intent: Coerce a preprocessed CNSet object from the crlmm package to a SnpArrayExperiment, perform wave correction, and fit the HMM.
input: cnSetExample (A CNSet object containing preprocessed copy number and B allele frequency data)
workflows.stages: 1. Coerce the CNSet object to a SnpArrayExperiment ;; 2. Perform wave correction using ArrayTV::gcCorrect to correct for GC content bias ;; 3. Fit the 6-state HMM using hmm2
workflows.code:
se <- as(cnSetExample, "SnpArrayExperiment")
res <- gcCorrect(lrr(se), increms=increms, maxwins=wins, returnOnlyTV=FALSE, verbose=TRUE, build="hg18", chr=chromosome(se), starts=start(se))
se2 <- se
assays(se2)[["cn"]] <- res$correctedVals
res <- hmm2(se2)
